messages:
maria.g: Heads-up — planning a rolling reboot of az5 GPU pool this Saturday 03:00-07:00 UTC to push the NIC firmware and pv-bmc microcode. This will be a soft drain (graceful) in 15-min cohorts.
eli: Which pools exactly? Hosted vs Dedicated? Any tenant impact expected?
samir: Targeting pool-gpu-az5-general and pool-gpu-az5-interruptible. Dedicated (reserved) pools are excluded unless a customer explicitly opts into maintenance window.
lin a: typo: lina: FYI APAC traffic peaks earlier, so 03:00-07:00 UTC maps to evening APAC — we should avoid 03:30-04:30 UTC if possible.
maria.g: Good call. We'll shift the hottest cohort out of 03:30-04:30. Plan: 03:00-03:15 cohort A, 03:20-03:35 B, etc, with 10–15m buffer between cohorts for KV cache warmup and prefix-cache seeding.
eli: How are we hedging capacity? Can we pre-warm burst racks in eu-west to take traffic?
samir: Proposed hedges: 1) spin up 4 standby GPU nodes in eu-west1 (burst pool) 2) temporarily route latency-sensitive Hosted customers to eu-west via routing policy 3) enable small-model fallback (quantized-llm-v2-8bit) for background batch jobs.
kai: Cost note — spinning 4 nodes for 4h ~ ~ $X (will post calc). Is there a cheaper option like preemptible warmbackfill?
samir: Preemptible backfill is fine for non-SLA tenants but riskier for on-the-fly burst. We'll mix: 2 reserved warm nodes + 2 preemptible.
ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created: MNT-4319 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MNT-4319). Runbook link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/maintenance/MNT-4319.
lin a: lina: Can we run a canary on one rack first? Last time a NIC reboot caused transient packet drops for ~90s.
maria.g: Yes — step 0 = canary rack at 03:00 for cohort A. If packet drops > 2% in 5m we abort and rollback.
eli: What about KV cache seeding? If we drain too many prefix-homes, latency will spike. Need to run `kvseed` on reclaimed nodes before releasing.
samir: Agreed. Hook in prewarm job: `./tools/kvseed --pool pool-gpu-az5-general --concurrency 8 --ttl 3600` in the runbook. Add 8–12m after node joins before routing.
kai: I'm adding a short cost/impact blurb for ops-announce so SRE & finance know.
maria.g: Comm plan: ops-announce at T-48h, channel ping at T-2h, status updates every cohort, post-mortem in #postmortems. Any blockers?
eli: One ask — ensure Dedicated customers with active reserved capacity get explicit e-mail (not just slack). We need opt-out window 48h.
maria.g: Noted. I'll trigger the enterprise comms flow.
lin a: quick checklist snippet for oncall: 
```
- create MNT ticket
- canary rack reboot
- monitor egress packet drops
- run kvseed on rejoined nodes
- confirm prefix-cache hit-rate >= 90% before routing
- post cohort status
```
samir: Also add a step to toggle routing fallback to quantized-llm-v2-8bit for background batch routes if tail latency > 200ms.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Maintenance MNT-4319 will start Sat 03:00 UTC.
maria.g: Thanks all — I'll circulate updated timeline and the cost estimate. If no objections by EOD we'll lock schedule. :thumbsup:
